findings.summary: The change drops the provisional flag on MessageDraft and puts it into active use for nudges with no source-spec backing; the world spec's section 6 action list (Edit goal, Log contact, Open channel) has no Nudge, yet the new nodes cite that section.
findings.evidence:
-    provisional: true
+    description: ... no autonomous send. Used for nudges; screen description changed to 'Actions are Edit goal, Log contact, Nudge and Open channel' while keeping source { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }

findings.summary: The new criterion has no sourceRefs, unlike the neighbouring criteria, so it cannot be traced to any spec section.
findings.evidence: - id: C.webapp.nudge.single ... ownerKind: thing ... gates: [candidate, promotion] (no sourceRefs line, whereas the preceding criterion has sourceRefs: [S.webapp.operations])

findings.summary: The affordance's failure list covers only a missing connection, not the block case that its precondition and the criterion both say must be refused.
findings.evidence: preconditions: [Active Connection with this contact's linked account, No block in either direction] ... failure: [Not available when there is no active Connection]; claim: "... refused after disconnect or block"
